Author: StatCosol
Message:
feat: add ESS portal, enhanced dashboards, payroll engine, and leave management

- Add Employee Self-Service (ESS) portal with EMPLOYEE role, login, and
  dedicated Angular module (/employee routes) for profile, PF/ESI viewing,
  payslip downloads, nomination management, and leave apply/balance/history
- Enhance Client & Branch dashboards with expanded PF/ESI tables (DOJ, UAN,
  IP number, pending days), modal overlays, and contractor doc upload % with
  month-based tracking (doc_month column)
- Add leave management system: leave_policies, leave_balances,
  leave_applications, and leave_ledger tables with full CRUD + approval workflow
- Extend nomination workflow with client_id/branch_id scoping, submission/
  approval tracking, and Branch user approval endpoints
- Add payroll statutory engine (PF/ESI/PT calculators), payroll processing
  pipeline, setup configuration, register generation (PF ECR, ESI, statutory)
- Add employee management pages for Client portal (list, create, edit, detail)
- Add register viewer pages for Auditor, CCO, CEO, and Client portals
- Add branch approval pages for leave and nomination requests
- Add employee_statutory entity for detailed PF/ESI/PT member data
- Wire EssModule + ClientDashboardModule into AppModule, ESS_ROUTES into
  frontend routing, EMPLOYEE role into auth guards and JWT strategy

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Message:
Major platform update: v1.1 - Enhanced compliance, payroll, and multi-role features

Backend enhancements:
- Migrate from TypeORM to SQL-based migrations for better version control
- Add comprehensive admin module (actions, approvals, reports, masters)
- Implement auditor module with branch assignments and observations
- Add CRM module for contractor registration and branch management
- Implement LegitX module for compliance returns and audit reports
- Enhanced compliance system with MCD items, evidence versioning, document remarks
- Advanced payroll features: templates, client settings, registers, payslip archives
- Notifications inbox system with read tracking and message threading
- Branch documents and establishment management
- Contractor required documents workflow
- Enhanced authentication with password reset, refresh tokens, branch access control
- CEO/CCO dashboards with analytics
- Improved file handling and safe download utilities

Frontend application:
- Add complete Angular frontend with client, contractor, admin, auditor modules
- Responsive UI components and shared theme system
- Dashboard implementations for all user roles

Database improvements:
- Performance indexes on compliance tasks and notifications
- Governance model schema with approval workflows
- Soft delete support for compliance returns
- Branch-level compliance applicability and overrides

Testing and documentation:
- Comprehensive endpoint test suites for all roles
- API testing scripts (PowerShell and JavaScript)
- Extensive implementation and deployment documentation
- Database diagnostic and correction scripts
- Migration guides and schema documentation
